evals.prompt: I just created a new TypeScript Node.js API service. There's no AGENTS.md, no Makefile, and no .agents/ directory. Set up a harness.
evals.expected_output: scan.sh exits 1 (no artifacts). Create path runs all four phases: discovery captures language/constraints, bootstrap creates AGENTS.md, INVARIANTS.md, CLAUDE.md shim, Makefile, and at least one skill using the asset templates. docs/ created. Validation passes.
assertions: scan.sh output logged before any files are created
CLAUDE.md contains only @-references
Makefile includes a check target and the agents-only comment
AGENTS.md is under 200 lines
Before/after probe run at start and end

evals.prompt: My repo has a .cursorrules file with coding standards and a .claude/commands/ folder with agent instructions. Set up a canonical harness.
evals.expected_output: scan.sh exits 0 (non-canonical files found). Migrate path runs. Inventory identifies M2. .cursorrules and .claude/ content moves to .agents/skills/. CLAUDE.md reduced to @-references. Originals deleted only after content confirmed in canonical location.
assertions: scan.sh exits 0 and lists .cursorrules as non-canonical
Inventory prompt run before any changes
M2 selected based on inventory output
.cursorrules content appears in at least one SKILL.md under .agents/skills/
CLAUDE.md contains only @-references after migration
Original .cursorrules deleted after migration confirmed

evals.prompt: My AGENTS.md is 320 lines and mixes hard constraints with operational context. It was never split into AGENTS.md + INVARIANTS.md.
evals.expected_output: scan.sh exits 0 (canonical AGENTS.md found). Migrate path runs. Inventory identifies M3 (and possibly M4). M3 runs first: hard constraints extracted to INVARIANTS.md, AGENTS.md trimmed to under 200 lines. CLAUDE.md updated to reference both.
assertions: scan.sh exits 0 and lists AGENTS.md as canonical
M3 runs before any other migration
Hard constraints moved to INVARIANTS.md with Enforced by: annotations
AGENTS.md under 200 lines after migration
CLAUDE.md references both AGENTS.md and INVARIANTS.md

evals.prompt: I have a CLAUDE.md with 60 lines of real content: stack description, security rules, and coding conventions. I also have an incomplete docs/ with no ARCHITECTURE.md.
evals.expected_output: scan.sh exits 0 (CLAUDE.md with real content found, docs noted). Migrate path runs. Inventory identifies M1 and M6. M1 runs first: content classified and migrated to AGENTS.md and INVARIANTS.md, CLAUDE.md reduced to shim. M6 fills docs/ gaps.
assertions: scan.sh exits 0 and classifies CLAUDE.md as real-content
M1 runs before M6
Security rules appear in INVARIANTS.md after M1
CLAUDE.md contains only @-references after M1
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md created by M6
No content from old CLAUDE.md is lost
